d922b786-b9b4-448b-a4a8-797e14aeeefc.title: The Flower That Was Bloomed by a Cloud
d922b786-b9b4-448b-a4a8-797e14aeeefc.description:
Hong Lyon, a pitiful young princess only in title, who has no power nor authority, meets a young nobleman named Dowun who offers to help her take what's rightfully hers… but at what cost?  
  
Winner of the 2019 Tory Comics Award.

04f84c92-2849-412c-a161-93a55ec119e2.description: "Put on a uniform and become a high school student!" 27-year-old office worker Mone Saionji is begged by her roommate, manga artist Koharu Uzuki purposes," and for some reason agrees. And then she goes out like that!? Mone, who has always been serious and hardly played around during her school days, can't stop feeling nervous... The coming-of-age comedy of two adult women begins!

38c6f934-7558-4d1b-80d1-91114e0419eb.title: Level 1 kara Hajimaru Shoukan Musou: Ore dake Tsukaeru Ura Dungeon de, Subete no Tenseisha o Bucchigiru
38c6f934-7558-4d1b-80d1-91114e0419eb.description:
Shinobu Iijima kehilangan nyawanya bersama adik perempuan,
 Ketika dia bangun, dia sudah bereinkarnasi di dunia game yang dia mainkan.
 Shinobu putus asa untuk memulai permainan dari awal setelah ayah angkatnya menghapus data gamenya, tetapi dia mengetahui bahwa adik perempuannya akan segera bereinkarnasi di dunia ini juga.
 Untuk menghentikan ayah angkatnya menjadi pemain top yang mengincar tubuh adik perempuannya, dia akan memulai jalan menuju yang paling menyakitkan ...!

8f9aaf0e-0894-4e67-896e-ff5bf072cc57.title: Karasu no Danna-sama!
8f9aaf0e-0894-4e67-896e-ff5bf072cc57.description: Nitori is looking forward to a sweet and calm life of a newlywed together with his husband the raven god Karasuma. However, that tranquility, and their very relationship, is put to the test when they visit together Karasuma's homeland. Is there a warm nest and baby chicks is the future of the newlyweds, or...?

331660d5-a2f4-47d8-8da8-99dfe5277e56.title: Ikitsuku Saki wa Yuusha ka Maou ka: Moto Hai Player ga Iku Isekai Kouryakuki
331660d5-a2f4-47d8-8da8-99dfe5277e56.altTitle: Is the Destination a Hero or a Demon King?
331660d5-a2f4-47d8-8da8-99dfe5277e56.description:
"I've found you!"

Mamiya Yuuto was transported into another world after hearing those words, but all he got out of it were a younger body and the ability to see his status screen at any time — in overwhelming detail. Survive in a different world with skills and magic, armed with the experience of working life and the knowledge and perseverance of a retired gamer!
___
**Original Web Novel:** [Kakuyomu](https://kakuyomu.jp/works/16816452221304277639), [Syosetu](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n4214hb/)

01eca861-048f-465b-94cd-46fb862b4dc6.title: Shuuen no Shiori
01eca861-048f-465b-94cd-46fb862b4dc6.description:
On the normal, unchanging campus, it suddenly occurred; A murder case where a body was cut open, right into two.  
On the other side of the unsolved case, the rumor-loving high school students became involved in a certain ritual.  
From the extremely popular songs on Nico Nico Douga, begins the Project.  
  
What is the “Bookmark of Demise”…?   
Who is the traitor…?   
What will the conclusion to this story be…?  
  
So, can you solve this mystery?

91f7d0b8-2284-4f42-a3dd-e34a3f3618e5.title: Saitei Chingin no Maou: Rekidai Saikyou no Maougun, Sono Ashi o Hipparu no ga Oshigoto desu
91f7d0b8-2284-4f42-a3dd-e34a3f3618e5.altTitle: The Minimum Wage Demon King: My Job Is to Get in the Way of the Strongest Demon King's Army in History
91f7d0b8-2284-4f42-a3dd-e34a3f3618e5.description:
Aquas Trussler is a bronze-rank adventurer who lives only for his hobbies and training, content with his simple life. Everything changes when Uiras, the Goddess of Creation, offers him an unexpected job: become the Demon King and oppose the strongest Demon King's army in history.

The pay? Nothing more than minimum wage.

Even so, Aquas accepts the offer, beginning the story of the most underpaid Demon King ever.
